## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Singapore, Singapore. It starts at Universal Studios Singapore, 8 Sentosa Gateway.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Go beyond the screen with Universal Studios Singapore tickets! This iconic theme park couples some of cinema's biggest stars with cutting-edge technology and special effects. The result is an experience that the whole family will treasure forever!

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €59.38. It was rated 4.5 out of 5 from 115 ratings and 34 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
